## What changed

Describe the problem and the implemented solution.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`

## Safety review

- [ ] No secrets or real trading data were added.
- [ ] Stored-data changes include validation and a migration plan.
- [ ] Privacy and network behavior are unchanged or documented.
- [ ] UI changes include mobile and accessibility verification.
